data.name: Wild West Poker: Cheat, Bet, or DIE
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Wild West, where poker and revolvers decide everything.

This is a multiplayer PvP game featuring voice chat, poker, and deadly shootouts. Your goal is simple: become the last player alive or the last player with money.

At the poker table, the strongest hand wins. But who said you have to play fair? You can secretly swap cards in your hand with fake ones, creating powerful combinations and deceiving your opponents.

Be careful, though. If another player catches you cheating, they have the right to shoot you on the spot and take all of your money without any penalty.

But this town isn't lawless. A Sheriff watches over every game. Killing an innocent player is a crime, and anyone reckless enough to do it will be immediately executed by the Sheriff.

Features

  • 🤠 Multiplayer PvP gameplay

  • 🎙️ Proximity voice chat for bluffing, negotiating, and accusing others

  • 🃏 Poker with unique cheating mechanics

  • 🔫 Shootouts and high-stakes confrontations

  • ⭐ Sheriff system that enforces the law

  • 💰 Risk everything to become the richest player at the table

Will you play fair, master the art of deception, or gun down a guilty cheater before they do the same to you?

Good luck, cowboy. 🤠🔫🃏💰
